rubric.role_summary: Senior product manager owning end-to-end product development for an AI-powered government operations platform, from customer discovery and strategy through launch and iteration, working with engineering, design, and deployments.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior product manager owning end-to-end product development for an AI-powered government operations platform, from customer discovery and strategy through launch and iteration, working with engineering, design, and deployments.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years in product management.
- Hands-on experience building agents, prototypes, or AI-powered workflows.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- B2B SaaS product experience.
- Track record of shipping products end-to-end, from discovery and definition through launch and iteration.
- Experience leading cross-functional teams in fast-paced, low-structure environments.
- Experience using metrics and experimentation to test ideas, learn from user feedback, and iterate.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Boston area, Massachusetts. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): This role is based in Boston, in-person at least 1 day a week.

soft_requirements: High agency, comfort with ambiguity, bias to action, and willingness to help hands-on outside usual product duties.
Strong product, user, and business instincts and sensitivity to workflow nuance.
Ability to communicate product vision and tradeoffs to diverse audiences.
Creativity and consistency in applying AI to personal product processes.
Urgency, ownership, and commitment to product quality.
